title: Travel
description: Get from one place to another and ask for help doing it.

questions.sentence: Apana kouthi jauchhanti?
options: Mu Puri jauchhi.
Mu bus re asuchhi.
Mu station re achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu Puri jauchhi.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to Puri.

questions.sentence: E bus kouthi jae?
options: E bus Cuttack jae.
Mu bus re jauchhi.
Bus station pakhare achi.
questions.correctAnswer: E bus Cuttack jae.
questions.translatedSentence: This bus goes to Cuttack.

questions.sentence: Mu train re Puri jauchhi.
options: I am going to Puri by train.
I am going to Puri by bus.
I came to Puri by train.
questions.correctAnswer: I am going to Puri by train.

questions.sentence: Station kouthi achi?
options: Station ethi pakhare achi.
Station sakalu khule.
Mu station re kama kare.
questions.correctAnswer: Station ethi pakhare achi.
questions.translatedSentence: The station is near here.

questions.sentence: Bus station kouthi achi?
options: Where is the bus station?
Where is the train station?
How far is the bus station?
questions.correctAnswer: Where is the bus station?

questions.sentence: Apana train re jauchhanti ki?
options: Nahin, mu bus re jauchhi.
Train station pakhare achi.
Mu train ra naam jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, mu bus re jauchhi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am going by bus.

questions.sentence: E train Cuttack jae nahin.
options: This train does not go to Cuttack.
This train goes to Cuttack.
This bus does not go to Cuttack.
questions.correctAnswer: This train does not go to Cuttack.

questions.sentence: Tume kete belaku jauchha?
options: Mu ebe jauchhi.
Mu bus re jauchhi.
Mu Cuttack jauchhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu ebe jauchhi.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going right now.

questions.sentence: Mo bus ebe asuchhi.
options: My bus is coming now.
My bus is not coming.
My train is coming now.
questions.correctAnswer: My bus is coming now.

questions.sentence: Puri pain ticket kete taka?
options: Ticket pachasa taka.
Ticket ghara ethi achi.
Ticket sakalu milibe.
questions.correctAnswer: Ticket pachasa taka.
questions.translatedSentence: The ticket costs fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Mote Puri pain dui ta ticket darkar.
options: I need two tickets to Puri.
I need one ticket to Puri.
I want to go to Puri by train.
questions.correctAnswer: I need two tickets to Puri.

questions.sentence: Ticket ghara kouthi achi?
options: Ticket ghara station bhitare achi.
Ticket ghara sata ta baje bandha hue.
Mu ticket katisarichi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ticket ghara station bhitare achi.
questions.translatedSentence: The ticket counter is inside the station.

questions.sentence: Train kete belaku chhadiba?
options: Train sata ta baje chhadiba.
Train sidha Cuttack jae.
Train re bhida beshi achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Train sata ta baje chhadiba.
questions.translatedSentence: The train leaves at seven o'clock.

questions.sentence: Arka bus kete belaku asiba?
options: What time will the next bus come?
Where will the next bus go?
How much is the next bus ticket?
questions.correctAnswer: What time will the next bus come?

questions.sentence: Apana aji jibe na kaali jibe?
options: Mu kaali sakalu jibi.
Mu bus re jibi.
Mu Bhubaneswar jibi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu kaali sakalu jibi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will go tomorrow morning.

questions.sentence: Mu kaali sakalu sata ta train re jibi.
options: I will go by the seven o'clock train tomorrow morning.
I will go by the seven o'clock bus tomorrow morning.
I went by the seven o'clock train this morning.
questions.correctAnswer: I will go by the seven o'clock train tomorrow morning.

questions.sentence: E ticket re mu Cuttack jai pariba ki?
options: Nahin, e ticket kebala Puri pain.
Ha, ticket ghara station bahare achi.
Nahin, mu Cuttack rasta jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, e ticket kebala Puri pain.
questions.translatedSentence: No, this ticket is only for Puri.

questions.sentence: Ebe ticket nahin, sabu bikri hoigala.
options: There are no tickets now, everything is sold out.
There are tickets now, but they are very expensive.
The tickets will be sold tomorrow morning.
questions.correctAnswer: There are no tickets now, everything is sold out.

questions.sentence: Jagannath mandira kouthi achi?
options: Sidha jantu, mandira bama pate achi.
Mandira bahuta sundara achi.
Mu mandira bhitare achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Sidha jantu, mandira bama pate achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Go straight, the temple is on the left.

questions.sentence: Ethu station kete dura achi?
options: How far is the station from here?
Which way is the station from here?
How do I go to the station from here?
questions.correctAnswer: How far is the station from here?

questions.sentence: Kshama karantu, bus stand kou pate achi?
options: Dahana pate jantu, bus stand pakhare achi.
Bus stand sakalu pachata baje khule.
Mu bus stand ru asuchhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Dahana pate jantu, bus stand pakhare achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Go to the right, the bus stand is nearby.

questions.sentence: E rasta station ku jae ki?
options: Ha, e rasta sidha station ku jae.
Ha, station bhitare ticket ghara achi.
Nahin, e rasta bahuta bhala nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, e rasta sidha station ku jae.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this road goes straight to the station.

questions.sentence: Mu ehi sahara jane nahin, tike sahajya karantu.
options: I do not know this city, please help me a little.
I know this city well, so I can help you.
I do not know this road, please show me on the map.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not know this city, please help me a little.

questions.sentence: Ethi pakhare auto milibe ki?
options: Ha, tike age gale auto stand achi.
Ha, auto bhada ebe beshi achi.
Nahin, mu ebe auto re jauchhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, tike age gale auto stand achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, there is an auto stand a little ahead.

questions.sentence: Bama pate jantu, tapare dahana pate jantu.
options: Turn left, and after that turn right.
Turn right, and after that turn left.
Go straight, and after that turn left.
questions.correctAnswer: Turn left, and after that turn right.

questions.sentence: Chali chali jiba pain kete samaya lagiba?
options: Chali chali dasa minute lagiba.
Auto bhada chalisha taka lagiba.
Rasta ebe bahuta bhala achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Chali chali dasa minute lagiba.
questions.translatedSentence: It takes ten minutes on foot.

questions.sentence: Mu bata bhuli gali, ebe kouthi jibi?
options: I have lost my way, where should I go now?
I have found the way, so where should we go now?
I forgot the address, where do you want to go now?
questions.correctAnswer: I have lost my way, where should I go now?

questions.sentence: Puri station jiba pain kete bhada hoba?
options: Sahe taka hoba, apana asantu.
Auto stand sidha rasta re achi.
Mu ebe Puri ru asuchhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Sahe taka hoba, apana asantu.
questions.translatedSentence: It will be one hundred rupees, please get in.

questions.sentence: Meter re chalantu, mu beshi paisa deba nahin.
options: Go by the meter, I will not pay more.
Go by the meter, I will pay you later.
Drive slowly, I will not pay you more.
questions.correctAnswer: Go by the meter, I will not pay more.

questions.sentence: Apana meter re jibe ki?
options: Nahin, mu meter re jae nahin.
Ha, mo auto bahuta purana achi.
Nahin, station ethi pakhare achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, mu meter re jae nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I do not go by the meter.

questions.sentence: Bhada bahuta beshi lagucchi, tike kama karantu.
options: Thik achi, dasa taka kama karidebi.
Thik achi, mu ebe ghara jauchhi.
Ha, meter ebe thik chaluchhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik achi, dasa taka kama karidebi.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, I will reduce it by ten rupees.

questions.sentence: Mote Jagannath mandira pakhare chhadi dianthu.
options: Please drop me near the Jagannath temple.
Please pick me up near the Jagannath temple.
Please take me inside the Jagannath temple.
questions.correctAnswer: Please drop me near the Jagannath temple.

questions.sentence: Mu kouthi rokibi?
options: Ethi rokantu, mu ethi ohlaibi.
Auto bhada sahe taka lagiba.
Mandira bama pate rahichi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ethi rokantu, mu ethi ohlaibi.
questions.translatedSentence: Stop here, I will get down here.

questions.sentence: Tike jore jantu, nahinle mo train chhadi jiba.
options: Please go a little faster, otherwise my train will leave.
Please go a little slower, otherwise my train will leave.
Please go a little faster, because my bus has already left.
questions.correctAnswer: Please go a little faster, otherwise my train will leave.

questions.sentence: Apananka pakhare khuchura paisa achi ki?
options: Nahin, mo pakhare khuchura nahin.
Ha, mo pakhare dui ta ticket achi.
Nahin, mu apananku bhada dei sarichi.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, mo pakhare khuchura nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I do not have any change.

questions.sentence: Jadi rasta re bhida beshi thae, tebe taxi re jiba bhala.
options: If there is a lot of traffic on the road, it is better to go by taxi.
If there is a lot of traffic on the road, it is better to go by auto.
Because there is a lot of traffic on the road, the taxi will not come.
questions.correctAnswer: If there is a lot of traffic on the road, it is better to go by taxi.

questions.sentence: Aji ratiku gote ruma milipariba ki?
options: Ha, upara mahala re gote ruma khali achi.
Ha, hotel station pakhare rahichi.
Nahin, mu ebe hotel ku asuchhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, upara mahala re gote ruma khali achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, there is one room free on the upper floor.

questions.sentence: Gote ratiku kete taka lagiba?
options: How much does it cost for one night?
How much does it cost for one week?
How many nights will you stay here?
questions.correctAnswer: How much does it cost for one night?

questions.sentence: Apana kete dina rahibe?
options: Mu tini dina rahibi.
Mu Bhubaneswar ru asuchhi.
Mu ruma tike dekhibi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu tini dina rahibi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will stay for three days.

questions.sentence: Ruma re garam pani achi ki?
options: Ha, sakalu garam pani ase.
Ha, ruma dui tala re achi.
Nahin, aji koudi ruma khali nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, sakalu garam pani ase.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, there is hot water in the morning.

questions.sentence: Mo ruma ra chabi harei gala, tike arka gote dianthu.
options: I have lost my room key, please give me another one.
I have found my room key, please keep another one.
My room key is not working, please repair it now.
questions.correctAnswer: I have lost my room key, please give me another one.

questions.sentence: Sakala jalakhia kete belaku milibe?
options: Jalakhia sata ta ru na ta paryanta milibe.
Jalakhia pain pachasa taka lagiba.
Jalakhia re pakhala aau dalma achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Jalakhia sata ta ru na ta paryanta milibe.
questions.translatedSentence: Breakfast is served from seven until nine.

questions.sentence: E ruma tike chhota, aau bada ruma achi ki?
options: This room is a little small, is there a bigger room?
This room is a little dirty, is there a cleaner room?
This room is very big, but it is too expensive.
questions.correctAnswer: This room is a little small, is there a bigger room?

questions.sentence: Ruma re wifi chaluchhi nahin, tike dekhantu.
options: Thik achi, mu ebe loka pathauchhi.
Thik achi, apananka ruma tini tala re achi.
Ha, garam pani rati re ase nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik achi, mu ebe loka pathauchhi.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, I am sending someone now.

questions.sentence: Mu kaali sakalu bahari jibi, kintu mo bag ethi rakhi pariba ki?
options: I am leaving tomorrow morning, but can I keep my bag here?
I am leaving tomorrow evening, but can I keep my bag here?
I left this morning, but I forgot my bag here.
questions.correctAnswer: I am leaving tomorrow morning, but can I keep my bag here?

questions.sentence: Train kahinki eteka bilamba hela?
options: Barsha karana sabu train bilamba re chaluchhi.
Train tini number platform ru chhadiba.
Train ticket ebe milibe nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Barsha karana sabu train bilamba re chaluchhi.
questions.translatedSentence: All the trains are running late because of the rain.

questions.sentence: Mu deri hoigali, karana mo bus rasta re kharap hoigala.
options: I got late because my bus broke down on the way.
I got late because I could not find the bus stand.
I will be late because my bus has not come yet.
questions.correctAnswer: I got late because my bus broke down on the way.

questions.sentence: Apananka bag kemiti dekhajae?
options: Se gote kala rangara bada bag.
Bag bhitare mo ticket rahichi.
Mu bag train re rakhithili.
questions.correctAnswer: Se gote kala rangara bada bag.
questions.translatedSentence: It is a big black bag.

questions.sentence: Mo bag milila ki nahin?
options: Ebe sudha milinahin, kintu ame khojuchhu.
Ha, kala rangara bag bahuta bhari achi.
Nahin, apana ticket ghara ku jantu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ebe sudha milinahin, kintu ame khojuchhu.
questions.translatedSentence: It has not been found yet, but we are looking for it.

questions.sentence: Jadi mo bag milijae, tebe mote phone karantu.
options: If my bag is found, then please call me.
If my bag is not found, then please call me.
When my bag is found, I will call you.
questions.correctAnswer: If my bag is found, then please call me.

questions.sentence: Bus chhadi galani, ebe mu kana karibi?
options: Chinta karantu nahin, arka bus ghantae pare asiba.
Chinta karantu nahin, bus stand ethi pakhare achi.
Ha, bus bhada sahe taka padiba.
questions.correctAnswer: Chinta karantu nahin, arka bus ghantae pare asiba.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not worry, the next bus will come in an hour.

questions.sentence: Mo ticket harei gala, kintu mo pakhare tara gote photo achi.
options: I have lost my ticket, but I have a photo of it.
I have lost my ticket, and I do not have a photo of it.
I have found my ticket, but the photo is not clear.
questions.correctAnswer: I have lost my ticket, but I have a photo of it.

questions.sentence: Apana kaali paryanta ethi rahi paribe ki?
options: Nahin, karana mo train aji rati re achi.
Ha, mu kaali sakalu ethi asithili.
Nahin, mo ruma upara mahala re achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, karana mo train aji rati re achi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, because my train is tonight.

questions.sentence: Mu odia bhala bhabare kahi parena, kintu apana tike aste kahile mu bujhi paribi.
options: I cannot speak Odia well, but if you speak a little slowly I will understand.
I cannot speak Odia at all, so please write it down for me.
I speak Odia well, but I cannot understand when you speak fast.
questions.correctAnswer: I cannot speak Odia well, but if you speak a little slowly I will understand.
